title: Water Quality and Public Health
summary: Examining the links between water quality parameters and community health outcomes.
body: This research area focuses on characterizing contaminants in drinking water sources and assessing their relationship to public health outcomes across urban and rural communities in Bangladesh.

title: Urban Drainage and Stormwater Management
summary: Studying urban drainage systems and nature-based solutions for stormwater management.
body: Work in this area covers hydrological modeling of urban drainage networks and the evaluation of blue-green infrastructure as a mitigation strategy for urban flooding and waterlogging.
